name: Fujiwara
source:
An aggressive and fanatical messenger from Japan.
He grew up in a temple, and he is interested in Tang culture - especially Zhang Ruoxu's You Xian Ku.
"Even heroes fall for beauties, don't they?"
"You are drunken now? Well, that means you won't go anywhere today."
(Translated from Weibo)
